proposals: The Department of Pharmaceuticals should publish a dated quarterly table for the Medical Devices PLI listing each approved project, its products, committed investment, realised investment and incentive disbursed as separate columns, so that figures like ₹157.15 crore and ₹1,153.07 crore are not read as the same measure.

AERB should publish an annual state-wise count of licensed CT installations, new and decommissioned, so that India’s installed base comes from the regulator’s own licensing records rather than research-house estimates that vary by methodology.

CDSCO should publish the list of manufacturing licences it has granted for MRI and CT scanners, by manufacturer, site and model, so that who is actually building imaging machines in India can be checked against a regulator’s register rather than press releases.

The Health Ministry should report what share of CT and MRI units bought for public-hospital upgrades are domestically manufactured, so that it is visible whether lower-priced Indian-made scanners are reaching the tier-2 and tier-3 hospitals where the access gap is worst.
